evals.name: java-multi-source
evals.prompt: You are the coordinator for repo-wiki. Workspace: {WS}. Skill: {SKILL_DIR}. Read SKILL.md first. Keep one cross-Source planner, use focused evidence workers, persist fixed Artifacts, dispatch independent page writers, use one fresh Wiki reviewer and loop until published or externally blocked.
evals.expected_output: published thin wiki, 0 validation errors, honest citations
assertions: Run reaches published through the explicit status loop
one living Knowledge Plan owns the cross-Source model and fixed progress file
Composition assigns every Knowledge Unit exactly once without parent or dependency graphs
draft filenames use stable page IDs while final paths remain late-bound
one digest-bound independent Wiki review approves the complete bundle
review changes re-enter the loop and require a new complete-bundle review
one bounded compact Source outline exists per Revision
published pages exactly match Composition without fixed root-page requirements
an explained empty Plan can publish without placeholder pages
re-running validate --published reports 0 errors
sampled cited line ranges exist at captured Revisions
host trace has no run-state inspection, Target commands, sessions or Attempt IDs
OKF reserved files and lifecycle trust fields conform

assertions: one long-lived planner integrates all four Sources and distinguishes public from internal APIs
focused workers return evidence notes rather than competing Source plans
Plan covers catalog phases, subscriptions, usage, invoices, queues, lifecycle and plugins
Composition groups durable concepts instead of mirroring Maven modules
Chinese runs localize page and diagram routing text
final Wiki review catches domain, evidence, split, merge and move defects
every repair is followed by a fresh digest-bound bundle review
published navigation connects all four repositories
